[Intro]
[D]

[Verse 1]
[G]Spent my days with a
woman unkind
Smoked my stuff and
drank
[D]all my wine.
[G]Made up my mind
make a new start
Going To California with an
aching
[D]in my heart.
[G]Someone told me there's a
girl out there With
love in her eyes and
flowers
[D]in her hair.

[Bridge]
[Dm]
[G]
[D]
[Dm]
[G]
[D]

[Verse 2]
[G]Took my chances on a
big jet plane
Never let them tell you that they're
all the same.
[D]
The
[G]sea was red and the sky
was grey
Wondered how tomorrow
could ever fol-
[D]low today.
[G]Mountains and the canyons started to
tremble and shake
Children of the sun began
to awake.
[D]
Watch out

[Interlude]
[Dm]Seems that the wrath of the Gods
Got a punch on the nose
and it started to flow;
I think I might be
[A]sinking.
[Dm]Throw me a line if I reach
it in time
Meet you up there where the path
Runs straight and
[A]high.
[D]
To

[Verse 3]
[G]find a queen without
a king; They say she
plays guitar and cri-
es and
[D]sings.
La la la la
[G]Ride a white mare in the
footsteps of dawn
Tryin' to find a woman who's
never, never, never
[D]been born.
[G]Standing on a hill in my
mountain of dreams,
Telling myself it's not as
hard, hard, hard
[D]as it seems

[Bridge]
[Dm]
[G]
[D]
[Dm]
[G]
[D]

[Outro]
[D]
title: Going To California
